components.label: Hull timber
components.basis: hull-form model on the measured dimensions (AGS GA 223/28, Martin App. 11 p. 411); the hull taken as 35-55% of the laden displacement (an assumption)

components.label: Ballast
components.basis: scaled from the Santa María de la Rosa's excavated mound, about 90 t (Martin p. 150)

components.label: Siege cargo
components.basis: the Valencera's May 1588 issue list as the comparison (Martin pp. 115-116); Juliana's five carriage wheels

components.label: Masts, yards, sails, cordage
components.basis: 8-15% of the hull (an assumption)

components.label: Guns, shot, powder, lead, match
components.basis: the Lisbon muster's counts (Martin App. 4) times the libra and quintal (Martin p. ix); Juliana's weight-marked guns

components.label: Iron fittings and anchors
components.basis: iron-fastened Levant hulls (Martin p. 217); 4-10% of the hull

components.label: Food, wine, water, casks
components.basis: Medina Sidonia's ration scale (Martin pp. 349-350); days left by 25 September assumed

components.label: Soldiers' arms
components.basis: 6-14 kg per soldier mustered (an assumption)

oak_service_density.basis: t/m3 of hull timber in service, seasoned to wet; turns the budget's timber mass into volume. HYPOTHESIS

basic_density_waterlogged.basis: g/cm3 dry matter per wet volume after four centuries; with dry-matter density 1.5 g/cm3 it gives the wet bulk density. HYPOTHESIS

peg_tank_factor.basis: tank volume per m3 of dismantled timber (packing, solution, access). The Bremen cog needed an 800 m3 tank for one ship. HYPOTHESIS

peg_years.basis: years of PEG treatment: Vasa 17 (spray), Mary Rose about 19 (spray), Bremen cog about 18-20 (immersion); dismantled timbers may go faster

freeze_load_frac.basis: share of a freeze-dryer chamber filled per load. HYPOTHESIS

freeze_cycle_months.basis: months per freeze-drying load (La Belle, Texas A&M)

concretion_per_t_iron.basis: tonnes of concretion (iron, corrosion products, sand, shell, trapped shot) per tonne of original iron. HYPOTHESIS

electrolysis_tank_factor.basis: tank volume per m3 of concreted iron (solution around each object). HYPOTHESIS

iron_treatment_years.basis: years of desalination or electrolytic reduction per batch: about four years for cannon at the QAR lab; small finds faster

timber_stack_height_m.basis: effective height of timber in wet storage or tanks per m2 of floor. HYPOTHESIS

gun_floor_m2.basis: m2 of floor per gun in storage or display, with access and its carriage or cradle. HYPOTHESIS

predictions.title: breakup/prediction-inshore
predictions.observable: signed distance inshore of each wreck's keel line, in the site frame (frm:ITM), for every recovered gun with a recovery position
predictions.expected: distance inshore increases with mounting height (rank correlation > 0): castle pieces inshore, heavy low pieces near the keel and ballast
predictions.stated_before: 2026-11-07; no recovery positions held when stated
predictions.falsifier: light guns lie seaward of the keel line, or show no relation to mounting height

predictions.title: mass-budget/layer1-lavia
predictions.observable: mass of guns, great shot and lead from Lavia's wreck, once the site is fully surveyed
predictions.falsifier: a full inventory above the 95th percentile, or a record that guns or munitions were taken off the ship between the May muster and the wreck

predictions.title: mass-budget/layer1-juliana
predictions.observable: mass of guns, great shot and lead from Juliana's wreck, once the site is fully surveyed
predictions.falsifier: a full inventory above the 95th percentile, or a record that guns or munitions were taken off the ship between the May muster and the wreck

predictions.title: mass-budget/layer1-vison
predictions.observable: mass of guns, great shot and lead from Vison's wreck, once the site is fully surveyed
predictions.falsifier: a full inventory above the 95th percentile, or a record that guns or munitions were taken off the ship between the May muster and the wreck

predictions.title: mass-budget/layer2-lavia
predictions.observable: mass of Lavia's wreck on the seabed (ballast mound, lower hull, metal, guns and cargo), once the site is surveyed; and her ballast mound alone
predictions.stated_before: 2026-11-07; no ballast mound or timber extent measured at Streedagh
predictions.falsifier: a measured ballast mound outside the 5-95% range, or lower-hull timber extent implying a seabed mass outside it; or an issue list showing cargo beyond 60 t

predictions.title: mass-budget/layer2-juliana
predictions.observable: mass of Juliana's wreck on the seabed (ballast mound, lower hull, metal, guns and cargo), once the site is surveyed; and her ballast mound alone
predictions.stated_before: 2026-11-07; no ballast mound or timber extent measured at Streedagh
predictions.falsifier: a measured ballast mound outside the 5-95% range, or lower-hull timber extent implying a seabed mass outside it; or an issue list showing cargo beyond 60 t

predictions.title: mass-budget/layer2-vison

predictions.title: mass-budget/combined
predictions.observable: mass on the seabed from all three Streedagh wrecks, once Sites 1-3 are surveyed
predictions.falsifier: a whole-site survey placing the combined seabed mass outside the 5-95% range

predictions.title: magnetometry/resurvey-prediction
predictions.observable: ferrous mass at Sites 1-3 from a calibrated re-survey (total-field amplitudes, sensor altitude, positions in frm:ITM) inverted for magnetic moment
predictions.falsifier: a calibrated re-survey giving combined ferrous mass outside the 5-95% range
